story.zh: 刘虞与公孙瓒因政见不合，积怨已久，刘虞派人向公孙瓒缓和关系，公孙瓒反而筑城加以防备，刘虞决定出兵攻打公孙瓒。
story.en: Due to differing political views, long-standing grievances festered between Liu Yu and Gongsun Zan. When Liu Yu sent envoys to ease relations, Gongsun Zan instead fortified his city in defense. Liu Yu then decided to dispatch troops against Gongsun Zan.

trigger.zh: 蓟属刘虞，右北平属公孙瓒。
trigger.en: Ji belongs to Liu Yu, and Youbeiping belongs to Gongsun Zan.

forbidden.zh: 主角为刘虞、田畴、阎柔、公孙瓒、公孙范、公孙续时无法触发。
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Liu Yu, Tian Chou, Yan Rou, Gongsun Zan, Gongsun Fan, or Gongsun Xu.

participate.en: 【Belong to Liu Yu's or Gongsun Zan's Faction】
